summary.zh-TW: 點一張卡片，它會展開到最上方、其他卡片縮成一排；再點一次收合。版面只靠切換 CSS class，動畫全部交給 Flip 補上。
summary.en: Click a card and it expands to the top while the others shrink into a row; click again to collapse. The layout only toggles a CSS class — Flip fills in all the animation.

text.zh-TW: ① 先記下每張卡片「現在」的位置和大小。
text.en: ① First record where every card is and how big it is right now.

text.zh-TW: ② 直接切換 CSS class，版面會瞬間跳到新的樣子。版面完全由 CSS 決定，設計師可以只改 CSS 調整排版。
text.en: ② Toggle the CSS class and the layout jumps to its new state instantly. Layout is pure CSS, so a designer can restyle it without touching JS.

text.zh-TW: ③ Flip 會把每張卡片從「剛剛記下的位置」動畫到「新位置」。這三步驟就是 Flip 的全部用法。
text.en: ③ Flip animates every card from the recorded position to its new one. These three steps are all there is to Flip.

text.zh-TW: 動畫期間暫時把卡片改成絕對定位，卡片之間不會互相推擠變形。格狀版面切換時幾乎都要加。
text.en: Temporarily positions cards absolutely during the animation so they don’t push each other out of shape. Almost always needed for grid layout changes.

text.zh-TW: CSS 的 order 可以改變格子的排列順序，不用動 HTML。展開的卡片就是靠它排到最前面。
text.en: CSS order changes the visual order of grid items without touching the HTML. That’s how the expanded card moves to the front.
